sources.section: Content: Ownership of content / Similarity of content
sources.observation: Output ownership is assigned as between customer and OpenAI, to the extent allowed by law; outputs may resemble others. Input/use responsibility remains with the customer.
Output ownership is assigned as between customer and OpenAI, to the extent allowed by law; customer evaluates output and has responsibility for inputs.

limitations: Public provider output-ownership terms are the documented project-use basis. No account/order-form exception was inspected; no copyright eligibility, exclusivity or uniqueness asserted. Backend model ID was not exposed and remains unknown.
